title: Harry Potter - The Uninvited Guest (benchmark only, not for publication)
note: Fixed benchmark for comparing render routes on the same scenes and lines. Uses copyrighted characters: never publish. Voices are written descriptions, not preset names. No shot continues the previous frame: every one changes framing.

shots.visual: Wide shot of a lively Hogwarts lunch: Harry, Hermione and Ron eat at a long table; two distant owls cross high above the tables.

sound.ambience: warm Great Hall lunch: cutlery on pewter, goblets, low overlapping chatter

shots.visual: Hermione lowers her book and teases Ron with a dry look.
shots.camera: Steady close-up, eyeline just off camera right.

dialogue.speaker: Hermione
dialogue.voice: bright, quick, slightly bossy teenage girl with a British accent

shots.visual: Ron answers dryly, fork held safely below his mouth, subtle raised eyebrow.
shots.camera: Steady medium close-up, eyeline just off camera left.

dialogue.speaker: Ron
dialogue.voice: warm, dry, easygoing teenage boy with a British accent

shots.visual: Harry smiles at Ron; the owl beside a letter goes rigid and still.

sound.ambience: quiet hall chatter that dips as the owl freezes
effects: a single owl feather rustle, then a sudden hush

shots.visual: An owl on a beam snaps its head toward the entrance while the other owls wheel up into the rafters.

effects: sharp owl screech and a flurry of wings

shots.visual: First impact: a distant boom shakes the hall; Ron freezes, glances toward the entrance and speaks.

effects: deep distant boom with a stone rumble, goblets rattling on the table

dialogue.speaker: Ron
dialogue.voice: warm, dry, easygoing teenage boy with a British accent
dialogue.line: Please tell me that was a staircase.

shots.visual: Hermione rises and gives a firm warning, motioning her friends back; fine dust falls through the light.

effects: falling dust and pebbles pattering on stone, a second muffled boom far off

dialogue.speaker: Hermione
dialogue.voice: bright, quick, slightly bossy teenage girl with a British accent

shots.visual: The cracked entrance arch bursts inward: masonry and splintered doors collapse into the hall while students duck behind benches.

effects: enormous stone crash with splintering wood and rubble scattering across the floor, long reverberating hall echo

shots.visual: One huge dragon forefoot plants into the rubble; fragments jump and dust puffs outward.

effects: heavy thud of the dragon foot with rubble jumping and a low rumble

shots.visual: The dragon forces its shoulders through the breach into the hall, wings folded, dust shaking from the masonry.

effects: stone scraping against scales, deep reptilian breathing and a low rumbling growl, dust trickling

shots.visual: Harry holds his wand low, then lifts it to protect his friends, frightened but determined.
shots.camera: Tight calm close-up, eyeline off camera left.

effects: cloth rustle as the wand rises

dialogue.speaker: Harry
dialogue.voice: steady, quiet, determined teenage boy with a British accent

shots.visual: Black-robed Voldemort steps from beside the dragon foreleg into the light, then stops.

effects: slow footsteps on stone and heavy robes rustling

shots.visual: Voldemort finds Harry in the crowd and speaks quietly, lips barely moving.
shots.camera: Steady close-up, eyeline off camera left.

dialogue.speaker: Voldemort
dialogue.voice: soft, cold, unhurried adult male voice, almost a whisper, British accent

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of Voldemort eyes, a flicker of orange light reflected in them.

effects: faint crackle of fire and a low rumble
